targets.review_note: Fix a rectangle bottom row and a candidate height. In each puzzle, eligible columns have a vertical white run at least that height. A rectangle either lies inside one puzzle, or consists of a suffix of one boundary puzzle, any number of entirely eligible puzzles, and a prefix of a distinct boundary puzzle. All entirely eligible puzzles should be included because reordering is free; boundary pieces must be distinct and not already counted as full. Sweep heights downward, activating columns and joining adjacent active columns only within their original piece. DSU maintains longest internal run and whether a component reaches a piece boundary. Maintain total full-piece width and lazy heaps for the two best prefixes/suffixes from non-full pieces, testing distinct IDs. Every possible optimal height is some column height. Across all bottom rows there are at most the stated 100000 cells, giving O(N*M log M) work rather than enumerating piece permutations. Bind to earlier genuine write boundary CP-022baad1dda345a9 with the full task already present; the later 26545-token boundary is rejected intact, without truncation.
